hotkeys.query: OpenWhispr dictation hotkeys shortcuts hold tap activation mode
hotkeys.text:
Set your shortcut and choose when dictation records.

1. **Change the shortcut.** Open Settings → App → Hotkeys. Click the shortcut field and press your combination. It saves when registration succeeds; there is no separate Save or Apply button.
2. **Choose Tap or Hold.** Activation Mode is directly below Dictation Hotkey. Tap: press once to start and again to stop. Hold: hold while speaking and release to stop.

- **Availability:** Hold applies to dictation only and depends on your platform and shortcut. Voice Assistant, Translation and Meeting Mode have separate shortcuts.
- **Privacy:** Activation mode controls when recording starts and stops. It does not decide where audio is processed or guarantee local-only processing.

microphone.query: OpenWhispr choose microphone permissions no audio
microphone.text:
Choose an input, then check that it picks up your voice.

1. **Choose your microphone.** Open Settings → App → Preferences → Input Device. Choose a microphone or System Default.
2. **Check the input.** Speak and check the input level. “Waiting for microphone” can mean the device is unavailable, still opening or recovering; it does not necessarily mean permission was denied.
3. **Review permission.** If access is denied, check Settings → System → Privacy & Data.

**Keep in mind:** System Default follows your operating system’s input choice. A saved device choice or granted permission does not prove recording works.

models.query: OpenWhispr local models speech to text language models configuration
models.text:
Speech-to-text turns audio into words. Language models handle cleanup, Voice Assistant and Chat answers.

1. **Offline dictation.** Choose and download a local speech model under Settings → AI Models → Speech-to-Text → Dictation → Local.
2. **Local Chat.** Separately choose and download a supported local language model under Settings → AI Models → Language Models → Chat → Local.
3. **Before going offline.** Use the in-app catalog for available models and download the ones you need.

- **Separate selections:** Dictation, Note Recording and Audio Upload each have their own speech-to-text choice. Cleanup and Voice Assistant have independent language-model selections too.
- **Privacy:** A local speech model alone does not make Chat local. Hold is an activation mode, not a processing/privacy control. Cloud backup and connected tools are separate network features; these selections do not guarantee the whole app is offline.

meetings.query: OpenWhispr record meeting system audio permission speaker labels
meetings.text:
Meeting recordings use your microphone for your voice and system audio for other participants.

1. **Check permissions.** Open Settings → System → Privacy & Data. Connecting a calendar is optional for starting a recording and does not grant audio permissions.
2. **Choose the recording engine.** Open Settings → AI Models → Speech-to-Text → Note Recording.
3. **Check the input.** If you see “Waiting for microphone,” check your selected device and its connection, then review microphone permission. The input may be reconnecting or unavailable; permission was not necessarily denied.

**Keep in mind:** A saved permission status is not a recording test.

calendar.query: OpenWhispr connect calendar Google Microsoft Apple meetings
calendar.text:
Review your calendar connections under Integrations → Calendars.

- **Calendar access:** Connecting a calendar is separate from capturing meeting audio.
- **Audio permissions:** A calendar connection does not grant microphone or system audio permission.

language.query: OpenWhispr interface language transcription language translation
language.text:
Open Settings → App → Preferences to review language choices.

- **Interface language:** Controls the app’s interface, separately from transcription.
- **Transcription language:** Applies across recording activities.
- **Translation:** A separate feature with its own shortcut and target language.

backup.query: OpenWhispr cloud backup sync notes devices local storage
backup.text:
Cloud backup controls syncing notes across devices.

- **Processing:** Backup is separate from the model used for transcription or assistant answers.
- **Organization policy:** Your organization may restrict backup or processing choices.

assistant.query: OpenWhispr chat agent tools model availability voice assistant
assistant.text:
Chat has its own language-model selection.

1. **Choose the Chat model.** Open Settings → AI Models → Language Models → Chat. Speech-to-text, cleanup and Voice Assistant use separate selections.
2. **If a provider request fails.** Retry or review the selected Chat provider and model.

- **Tools:** Availability depends on the model, connections and organization policy. Small or unrecognized local models may run without tools.
- **Product help:** When the selected model supports tools, Chat can retrieve official documentation and read-only current settings to answer product questions. Help answers require a working model; open the official documentation if it is unavailable. Help cannot verify credentials or service availability from saved settings.
